creation_provenance.authorization: Existing owner-authorized Rhode Island Stage 2 phase persists through OWNER_GATE_1_READY. This request rehearses one exact 165-decision recommendation map against fresh-verified census rhode-island-stage2-census-0003. The map matches all 16 deterministic identity reviews to existing reciprocal games, uses accepted frozen Rhode Island H/A/N for all 79 site-type conflicts, preserves canonical authority by default for ordinary date/score/winner/non-site conflicts, upgrades the explicitly labeled 1978 and 1979 ECAC rows to CONFERENCE_TOURNAMENT, leaves the 1964 and 1966 UConn game-type conflicts canonical absent independent target evidence, keeps conference accomplishment counts at VERIFY_REFERENCE_VALUES, and enables publication only through the normal gated release path. No Owner Gate 1 approval/fill, sealing, apply, release, Preview, merge, Production, recovery, current-main refresh, or tracked basketball mutation authority is included.
